question:
Read the following passage and answer the question that follows. Some words have been replaced by blanks numbered (1) to (5).

Passage:
When Meena was appointed principal of the village school, she found the building in a state of complete ____(1)____. Many classrooms had no benches, and the roof leaked badly during the monsoon. Instead of complaining, she decided to ____(2)____ the matter with the villagers directly. She went from house to house and ____(3)____ them to contribute whatever they could. Within a year, the school had improved by leaps and ____(4)____, with new benches and a repaired roof. Today, the villagers are proud ____(5)____ their school and grateful to Meena.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
explanation: 'in a state of + noun' — 'of' के बाद noun आता है, इसलिए 'neglect' (उपेक्षा/बदहाली) सही है। 'neglected' और 'negligent' विशेषण हैं तथा 'neglecting' क्रिया-रूप है। Example: The garden was in a state of neglect.

Passage:
Rakesh was never fond of exercise. For years, he would ____(1)____ the morning walk that his doctor had advised, and whenever his wife reminded him, he would make an excuse and go back to sleep. Then a minor heart problem last year proved to be a blessing in ____(2)____. Frightened by the doctor's warning, he finally ____(3)____ walking for half an hour every day. By the time his neighbours wake up, he ____(4)____ already completed his walk and returned home. His friends, who had once laughed at him, now congratulate him ____(5)____ his remarkable discipline.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
explanation: 'skip' = छोड़ देना/टाल देना। संदर्भ: वह सैर टाल देता था और बहाना बनाकर सो जाता था। relish, enjoy और cherish का अर्थ आनंद लेना/संजोना है, जो संदर्भ के विपरीत है। Example: He skipped breakfast and rushed to the office.
